data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Rise as ‘Greed’ Persists: Analyst Says BTC Bulls Must Get ‘Moving’ From This Area
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies rose on Sunday as investors assessed the latest geopolitical developments in the Middle East and President Donald Trump’s potential intervention.The Sunday RallyBitcoin experienced a late-evening spike that nearly pushed it beyond $84,000, while Ethereum wobbled in a range…
